source_zh: 生气通天论 · 四、一日三时
source_en: Shengqi Tongtian Lun · IV. Three Times of Day
original: 故阳气者，一日而主外，**平旦人气生**，日中而阳气隆，日西而阳气已虚，气门乃闭。是故**暮而收拒**，无扰筋骨……
vernacular_zh: 阳气白天主外：清晨生发，中午最旺，傍晚已虚；所以**晚上要收敛安歇**，不扰动筋骨。
translation_en: Yang qi governs the outside by day: it rises at dawn, peaks at noon, and wanes at sunset, when the pores close. So **at dusk, draw in and rest;** do not strain the sinews and bones, and keep away from mist and dew.

scripture.text_zh: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇，吃劳碌得来的饭，本是枉然；惟有耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他**安然睡觉**。
scripture.text_en:
It is vain for you to rise up early,
to sit up late,
to eat the bread of sorrows:
for so he giveth his beloved **sleep**.

insight_zh: 岐伯：日西阳虚，**暮而收拒**；诗人：耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他**安然睡觉**。
insight_en: Qibo: as the sun sets, **draw in and rest**; Psalmist: he giveth his beloved **sleep**.
